reference.limits: rate limits granted at Trade Me's discretion (approved apps can request more); API Rules: access may be restricted or revoked for breaches; rate limits granted at Trade Me's discretion (approved apps can request more); submitted data must be accurate. Rate limit: 1,000 authenticated calls per hour per consumer application per user (HTTP 429), catalogue methods exempt. Registration is self-serve (developer portal); Jobs API contact api-jobs@trademe.co.nz. www.trademe.co.nz itself answers 406 to plain fetches and robots.txt has 309 Disallow rules.

fields.name: consumer_key
fields.help: Trade Me application consumer key (My Trade Me > My applications).

fields.name: oauth_token
fields.help: Member access token from the OAuth 1.0a flow (Trade Me access tokens do not expire).

fields.name: oauth_token_secret
fields.help: Access token secret from the same flow.

adapter.terms: Trade Me API: register an application under My Trade Me; production host api.trademe.co.nz, sandbox api.tmsandbox.co.nz. Calls are rate limited per application.

me.note: GET /v1/MyTradeMe/Summary.json ('Permission Required: MyTradeMeRead') returns the MemberSummary (MemberId, Nickname, ...).

search.note: GET /v1/Search/Jobs.json: search_string ('One or more keywords'), page ('starting from 1'), rows (max 500 when authenticated). location is not sent because Trade Me filters by numeric region / district ids (see the Localities catalogue). company, Region and StartDate (/Date(ms)/) come per job; JobType, District, Category and pay details stay in raw; description is the PayBenefits text.

get_posting.note: GET /v1/Listings/{listingId}.json: the full listing (Body, Attributes with job details, Agency for agency-posted jobs, ShortDescription).

not_offered.apply: The listing detail exposes HasAppliedForJob / JobApplicationDate only; the API reference documents no job-application method.
not_offered.list_messages: The Trade Me API reference documents no member-messaging method for job listings.
